name: Devdutt Padikkal
profileSummary: Devdutt Padikkal is an Indian cricketer who has played for the Indian national cricket team in Tests and Twenty20 Internationals (T20I). He made his international debut in July 2021 in a T20I against Sri Lanka and test debut in March 2024 against England. He plays for Karnataka in domestic cricket and Royal Challengers Bangalore in the Indian Premier League.
